reply.rationale: No defensible productive paradigm survives the evidence tests. The T1–T14 series fails the opaque index test: the numerals do not contribute literal count/degree meaning in a shared compositional frame, but instead select different stored procedures. Other repeated letters or substrings (e.g. AC, DE, ES, LI, LO, HI, PI, RC; single-letter symptom/location codes; lowercase symptom labels) do not form meaning-consistent substitution frames inside attested multi-morpheme codes. Although standalone key-like items exist for faces and qualities, there are no composed entries demonstrating those values alternating in the same morphotactic slot of larger codes. Therefore the safest analysis is a flat lexicon with every supplied symbol treated as an opaque stored label.
